headline: Republic Services Marks Nearly $1 Billion in Sustainability Investments in 2025
summary: Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG), a leader in the environmental services industry, today released its 2025 Sustainability Report, highlighting nearly $1 billion in sustainability investments during the year as the company continued to advance its 2030 Safety, Talent, Climate Leadership and Communities goals.
